output.reasoning: The buyer says the speaker works well but has a small scratch that was not in the listing, and your listing said new in box. Since you did not notice the scratch when packing, a PayPal reviewer would likely side with the buyer on the condition issue, so contesting is unlikely to succeed. Offering a partial refund of CAD 15 lets the buyer keep a working speaker and compensates them for the cosmetic flaw without giving back the full price.

evidenceUsed.point: The buyer's message on PayPal says the speaker has a small scratch on the back and they want to keep it but get some money back.
The buyer states the speaker works perfectly and the scratch was not mentioned in the listing.
The listing describes the item as a new Bluetooth speaker in box.
The seller states they did not notice a scratch when packing the item.
Canada Post tracking shows the order was delivered on 2026-10-19 with no signature required.

evidenceGaps: Photos or video of the speaker at the time it was packed, showing its condition
Any evidence that the scratch existed before shipping, such as packing records or inspection notes
Whether the buyer has sent photos of the scratch

alternatives.whyNot: A full refund would return the full price for a working item with only a minor cosmetic flaw, which is more than the facts support.
The listing said new in box and the seller has no evidence that the item was undamaged, so the case would likely be lost.

output.draftNote: Regarding this dispute, we have reviewed the buyer's report that the Bluetooth speaker works properly but has a small scratch on the back that was not in the listing. We are sorry for the disappointment and would like to resolve this quickly. We offer a partial refund of CAD 15.00 so the buyer can keep the speaker. Please let us know if you accept this offer.
nextSteps: Send the partial refund offer of CAD 15.00 through this dispute.
If you have packing photos or notes, add them before the dispute deadline.
Review your listing so the condition of used or flawed items is clearly stated in future listings.
